title: Smoke from the back offices, coworker inside

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: 911, what is the address of your emergency?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: 8866 Gulf Freeway, the Vibe office building. There's black smoke coming out of the offices on the north side!

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: What floor is the fire on?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: First floor. It's the first floor, in the back.

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: Is everyone out of the building?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: No! My coworker is still inside, she was in the office by the kitchen. I can't see her.

transcript.speaker: dispatcher
transcript.text: Okay, help is on the way. Anything dangerous inside, gas, chemicals?

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I think it smells like gas? There's a stove in the kitchen.

transcript.speaker: caller
transcript.text: I'm outside in the front parking lot.
